################################################################################
Purpose of script: To check the waic results of the experiments 
################################################################################

```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("../00_pck.R")
library(colorspace)

theme_set(theme_classic() + theme(strip.background = element_blank()))
dirs$outputs <- "../outputs/perpathogen"
dirs$tables <- "../outputs/tables"

pat_l <- c("rota", "vzv", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "hav", "men", "strep", "polio", "hib",
           "ipv", "opv", "dipht", "dtpa", "dtpw", "tetan", "pertu", "hbv",
           "multi_ipv", "multi_pertu", "multi_men", "multi_polio", "multi_opv",
           "multi_dtp", "multi_dtpa", "multi_dtpw", "multi_hib-men", "multi_mmr", "multi_mmr-vzv")
```

# Formulas 
```{r}
fun_waic_df <- function(pathogen = "rota") {
  
  file_path <- glue("{dirs$tables}/{pathogen}_tbl_waic_models.rds")
  
  # Create file if it does not exist 
  if (!file.exists(file_path)) {
    # Create the file
    waic_l <- data.frame()
    saveRDS(waic_l, file_path)
    cat("File created:", file_path)
  } else {
    waic_l <- readRDS(file_path)
    cat("File already exists:", file_path)
  }
  
  mod_files_l <- str_subset(str_subset(list.files(glue("{dirs$outputs}/{pathogen}")), "rds"), 
                            "bmv")
  mod_miss_l <- setdiff(mod_files_l, waic_l$mod)
  
  waic_miss_l <- sapply(mod_miss_l, function(miss) {
    readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/{pathogen}/{miss}"))$criteria$waic$waic 
  }, simplify = F)
  
  if(length(waic_miss_l) > 0) {
    waic_miss_l <- bind_rows(waic_miss_l) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "mod", values_to = "waic")
  }
  
  waic_l <- bind_rows(waic_miss_l, waic_l) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    arrange(-waic) %>%
    mutate(delta_waic = waic - waic[1]) 
  
  saveRDS(waic_l, file_path)
  return(waic_l)
}
```

# Extracting WAIC 
```{r}
# List of pathogens and extract waic
lapply(pat_l, fun_waic_df)

# One pathogen example 
fun_waic_df("rota") %>%
  filter(str_detect(mod, "csni", negate = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(waic) %>%
  mutate(delta_waic = waic - waic[1])

# All pathogens comparison 
all_waic <- sapply(pat_l, function(x) {
  fun_waic_df(x) %>%
    filter(str_detect(mod, "csni", negate = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(waic) %>%
    mutate(delta_waic = waic - waic[1])
}, simplify = FALSE)

bind_rows(all_waic, .id = "pathogen") %>%
  group_by(pathogen) %>%
  mutate(rn = row_number()) %>%
  filter(rn == 1)
```

# Sanity check:  Checking if the models converged 
```{r}
df_rhats_cs <- readRDS("../outputs/rhats/df_rhats_cs.rds")

bind_rows(all_waic, .id = "pathogen") %>%
  left_join(df_rhats_cs) %>%
  filter(Rhat == FALSE) %>%
  mutate(mod = str_replace(mod, "multi_", "multi"),
         mod = str_replace(mod, "reg_", "reg"),
         mod = str_remove_all(mod, ".rds|_gauss|-"),
         mod = str_replace(mod, "csi_", "csi")) %>%
  separate(mod, into = c("vac", "s", "pathogen", "mod")) %>%
  select(-s) %>%
  #filter(!(pathogen %in% c("multimmrv", "multihibmen"))) %>%
  mutate(vac = str_remove(vac, "bm")) %>%
  # mutate(pathogen = factor(pathogen,
  #                          levels = c("rota", "varicella",
  #                                     "multimmr", "measles", "mumps", "rubella",
  #                                     "multidtp", "dipht", "tetan", "multipertu", "pertu",
  #                                     "hbv", "hib",
  #                                     "multimen", "men",
  #                                     "multipn", "pn",
  #                                     "multipolio", "polio", "multiipv", "ipv", "multiopv", "opv"))) %>%
  group_by(pathogen) %>%
  arrange(waic) %>%
  mutate(delta_waic = waic - waic[1]) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = delta_waic, y = pathogen, color = mod)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) + 
  scale_x_sqrt(breaks = c(0,1,10,20,40,60,80)) + 
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 1), linetype = "dotted") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "grey", "pink","pink", "red", "darkred"))
  #facet_wrap(pathogen~.)
```

# For per pathogen only 
```{r}
selpat_l <- c("rota", "vzv", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "dipht", "tetan", "pertu", 
              "hbv", "men", "hib", "pn", "polio", "ipv", "opv")

selpat_l <- c("rota", "varicella", "multimmr", "multidtp", "pn", "hib", 
              "multimen", "hbv", "multiipv")

all_waic_df <- bind_rows(all_waic, .id = "pathogen") %>%
  left_join(df_rhats_cs) %>%
  filter(Rhat == FALSE) %>%
  mutate(mod = str_replace(mod, "multi_", "multi"),
         mod = str_replace(mod, "reg_", "reg"),
         mod = str_remove_all(mod, ".rds|_gauss"),
         mod = str_replace(mod, "csi_", "csi")) %>%
  separate(mod, into = c("vac", "s", "pathogen", "mod")) %>%
  select(-s) %>%
  filter(pathogen %in% selpat_l) %>%
  filter(mod %in% c("base", "cs", "csireg2b", "csireg3")) %>%
  mutate(vac = str_remove(vac, "bm")) %>%
  mutate(pathogen = factor(pathogen, levels = selpat_l)) %>%
  group_by(pathogen) %>%
  arrange(waic) %>%
  mutate(delta_waic = waic - waic[1])

pl_waic <- all_waic_df %>%
  filter(mod %in% c("cs", "base")) %>%
  mutate(delta_waic = waic - waic[1]) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = delta_waic, y = mod, color = mod)) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 1), color = "grey", linetype = "dotted") + 
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = 0, yend = mod), size = 2.5, alpha = 0.3) + 
  scale_x_continuous("Delta WAIC (log10)", trans = "log10") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "grey", "red","red", "red", "red")) +
  facet_grid(pathogen~., scales = "free") + 
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        strip.text.y = element_blank()) | all_waic_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = delta_waic, y = mod, color = mod)) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 1), color = "grey", linetype = "dotted") + 
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = 0, yend = mod), size = 2.5, alpha = 0.3) + 
  scale_x_continuous("Delta WAIC (log10)", trans = "log10") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "grey", "red","red", "red", "red")) +
  facet_grid(pathogen~., scales = "free") + 
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.title.y = element_blank()) 
  

ggsave(pl_waic, file = glue("outputs/figures/all_asel_mod_waic_sel.pdf"),
       height = 20, width = 5)
```

  mod_base_l[[i]] <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/{i}/bm{vtype}_s08_{i}_base_gauss.rds")))$residual__$cor) %>%

```{r}
pathogen = "rota"
mod_files_l <- str_subset(str_subset(list.files(glue("{dirs$outputs}/{pathogen}")), "rds"), "bmv")

mod <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/{pathogen}/{mod_files_l[2]}"))

library(brms)
library(tidybayes) 

get_variables(mod)

# For no interaction model 
mod %>%
  spread_draws(b_cos0.1208MUvac_week_v1, b_sin0.1208MUvac_week_v1,
               b_Intercept, b_sexM, b_age, b_vac_conc) %>%
  rename(cos_p = b_cos0.1208MUvac_week_v1,
         sin_p = b_sin0.1208MUvac_week_v1) %>%
  mutate(amp = (sqrt((cos_p^2) + (sin_p^2))),
         phs = atan(-(sin_p)/(cos_p)) + 52/pi*2) %>%
  #mutate(case_when(phs > pi/2 ~ phs - pi/2)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(amp, phs, b_Intercept, b_sexM, b_age, b_vac_conc, amp, phs)) %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
  summarise(mean(value), sd(value), quantile(value, 0.025), quantile(value, 0.975))

# For interaction model 

mod <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/{pathogen}/bmvl_s08_csi_reg_3.rds"))
get_variables(mod)

mod %>%
  spread_draws(`b_cos0.1208MUvac_week_v1`, `b_sin0.1208MUvac_week_v1`,
               `b_reg_32_Tropical:cos0.1208MUvac_week_v1`, `b_reg_33_Temperatesouth:cos0.1208MUvac_week_v1`,                      
               `b_reg_32_Tropical:sin0.1208MUvac_week_v1`, `b_reg_33_Temperatesouth:sin0.1208MUvac_week_v1`,
               `b_Intercept`, `b_sexM`, `b_age`, `b_vac_conc`) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(contains("cos"), contains("sin"))) %>%
  mutate(cosine = case_when(str_detect(name, "cos") ~ "cos_p",
                            str_detect(name, "sin") ~ "sin_p"),
         name = str_remove_all(name, "cos0.1208|sin0.1208")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = cosine, values_from = value) %>%
  group_by(.chain, .iteration, .draw) %>%
  mutate(inter = cos_p + cos_p[1])
  mutate(amp = (sqrt((cos_p^2) + (sin_p^2))),
         phs = atan(-(sin_p)/(cos_p))) %>%
  rename(reg = name) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(amp, phs, b_Intercept, b_sexM, b_age, b_vac_conc, amp, phs)) %>%
  mutate(reg = case_when(name %in% c("amp", "phs") ~ reg)) %>%
  group_by(name, reg) %>%
  summarise(mean(value), sd(value), quantile(value, 0.025), quantile(value, 0.975))

conditional_effects(mod)
```


```{r}
mod %>%
  spread_draws(`b_cos0.1208MUvac_week_v1`, `b_sin0.1208MUvac_week_v1`,
               `b_reg_32_Tropical:cos0.1208MUvac_week_v1`, `b_reg_33_Temperatesouth:cos0.1208MUvac_week_v1`,                      
               `b_reg_32_Tropical:sin0.1208MUvac_week_v1`, `b_reg_33_Temperatesouth:sin0.1208MUvac_week_v1`,
               `b_Intercept`, `b_sexM`, `b_age`, `b_vac_conc`) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(contains("cos"), contains("sin"))) %>%
  mutate(cosine = case_when(str_detect(name, "cos") ~ "cos_p",
                            str_detect(name, "sin") ~ "sin_p"),
         name = str_remove_all(name, "cos0.1208|sin0.1208")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = cosine, values_from = value) %>%
  mutate(amp = (sqrt((cos_p^2) + (sin_p^2))),
         phs = atan(-(sin_p)/(cos_p))) %>%
  rename(reg = name) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(amp, phs, b_Intercept, b_sexM, b_age, b_vac_conc, amp, phs)) %>%
  mutate(reg = case_when(name %in% c("amp", "phs") ~ reg)) %>%
  group_by(name, reg) %>%
  summarise(mean(value), sd(value), quantile(value, 0.025), quantile(value, 0.975))
```

               # base model cs random coefficients 
               brm_l$bm1ds0_cs.rds,
               # cs random coefficients

               # cs interaction and random coefficients highest
